Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ Return - Type E_ OK: will be returned if the WUF flag has been cleared. E_ NOT_ OK: will be returned if the WUF flag has not been cleared or a development error occurs. Description Clears the WUF flag in the transceiver hardware. This API shall exist only if Can Specification of CAN Transceiver Driver AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 43 of 83 Document ID 71 : AUTOSAR_SWS_CANTransceiverDriver - AUTOSAR confidential - Trcv Hw Pn Support = TRUE. Available via Can Trcv.h
